paper.title_en: A Majorana Relativistic Quantum Spectral Approach to the Riemann Hypothesis in (1+1)-Dimensional Rindler Spacetimes
paper.abstract_en: We present a Hilbert--Pólya approach to the Riemann zeta function via a Mellin--Barnes integral for massive Majorana modes in $(1+1)$-dimensional Rindler spacetime. The boost spectrum is continuous on the full wedge and discrete with a reflecting wall. Summing positive momentum modes on a transverse circle yields $ζ(2s)$ in the radial Mellin transform. Building on our one-sided Cesàro criterion for additive correlations of $Λ(n)-1$, we assign each prime $p$ a chiral channel of optical length $\tfrac12\log p$. Its $k$th return at $u=k\log p$ carries weight $\log p$. The centered correlation obeys $C(u)\le C(0)$ for all real $u$ exactly when the Riemann hypothesis (RH) holds. For a Majorana oscillator with linear mass profile, a bounded self-adjoint function of its Hamiltonian assigns period $kT_1$ to mode pair $k$. The first $n$ pairs have least common period $T_n=T_1\operatorname{lcm}(1,\ldots,n)$, so $\log(T_n/T_{n-1})=Λ(n)$ for $n\ge2$. Set $m=\lceil\sqrt{x}\rceil$, $N=\lfloor mx\rfloor$, and $ψ(y)=\sum_{n\le y}Λ(n)$. The signed revival mean $A(x)=m^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{m-1}(N/j-ψ(N/j))$ satisfies $A(x)=R(x)+o(\sqrt{x})$, where $R(x)=\sum_{n\le x}Λ(n)(x/n-1)-x\log x+(1+γ_{\mathrm E})x$. At each zeta zero $ρ$ of multiplicity $d$ with $\Re(ρ)>1/2$, the meromorphic continuation of $\int_2^\infty A(x)x^{-s-1}\,dx$ has a simple pole of residue $d/[ρ(1-ρ)]$. For fixed $λ>1$, $1/2<θ<\Re(ρ)$ and $K>0$, the Kaczorowski--Pintz theorem gives $A(x)>Kx^θ$ at some $x\in[Y,Y^λ]$ for all large $Y$. Thus RH follows if for each $\varepsilon>0$ there is a $C_\varepsilon$ with $A(x)\le C_\varepsilon x^{1/2+\varepsilon}$ throughout $[Y,Y^λ]$ for arbitrarily large $Y$. For $λ=3/2$, the independent theta-lift estimate reported by Alpöge and Claude for $G=R$ gives this bound for $A$.
